policy.identity: Exact 2024–25 NCES LEA 4218990 / PA-126515001 / native AUN 126515001 ownership. Official numeric school numbers and digit strings normalize to nine digits under the same AUN; retain original CCD ST_SCHID and 12-digit NCES separately. School-number zero is not a building. No names, NCES suffix guessing, foreign charter LEAs, corrected digits or enrollment joins establish identity.
policy.population: Prospective pure lower profiles require exact operational CCD ownership, complete unadjusted reported lower offers with grade 3–8 and no grades 9–13/UG/AE, and original October native enrollment with all grades 9–12 explicit zero and positive tested-grade enrollment. Offered and enrolled configurations remain separate; original high/mixed/inactive/primary/unknown records and all subgroup/grade PSSA rows remain source evidence, never pooled by labels or fit diagnostics.
policy.income: Original October 1, 2024 PIMS individual Economic Disadvantaged Status Code field 88: each school’s own low-income enrollment divided by its own same-year total enrollment, including enrolled pre-K/kindergarten categories. TANF, census poor, Medicaid, neglected/delinquent institutions and foster homes are allowed poverty sources; recent reliable FRPL is a fallback. CEP must use individual poverty sources, not universal meal eligibility. Field 131 food-program eligibility remains separate. Local poverty-source choice and reporting coverage are unknown; this is a broader state proxy, not uniform FRPL or family income.
policy.income_precision: The published income proportion truncates to four decimals. Preserve it and raw numerator/denominator, but use the precise own count ratio. No other year, LEA allocation, another enrollment, CEP multiplier, threshold-filtered >30% worksheet or universal meals substitutes. Missing or masked income never means zero.
policy.assessment: Original 2025 regular PSSA All Students / Total school rows for Math and ELA, spanning native tested grades 3–8. Use Percent Proficient and above directly as published, with one-decimal rounding; never add rounded levels, average grade percentages or reconstruct suppression. PSSA excludes separate PASA alternate assessment and Keystone end-of-course scope.
policy.assessment_population: Original workbook notes exclude pupils enrolled after October 1, homeschoolers, excluded school aggregations, ELL enrolled for less than one year, LIFE pupils entering EL after the previous testing window, and pupils who did not attempt. This is the published accountable scored population, not every spring enrollee.
policy.suppression: All original typed masks and explicit zeros remain distinct. Suppressed rates are not reconstructed from scores, neighboring groups or levels. Strict integer counts and row references reject booleans and integral-float aliases.
policy.counts: Number Scored is the original scored-assessment denominator for the same regular PSSA All Students / Total rate. Published usable totals require at least 11 scored and reconciling native performance percentages. Preserve smaller scored counts with their masked rates and all raw subgroup/grade rows; enrollment, participation and federal 95%-rule counts never substitute. Source-only audit computes no variances, intervals or studentization.
policy.combined: Equally weighted mean of usable original Math and ELA published total rates, not proficient in both. Preserve each subject’s own verified Number Scored; no invented joint denominator or source-only variance.
policy.discrepancies: Retain native LEA, school and CCD enrollment/income totals as separate observations. Native building 9999 has no school-level income; numerical coincidences or district differences never allocate its income or identify a cause.
policy.eligibility: Reconstruct exact original Philadelphia CCD and Pennsylvania AUN/school identities, operational status, complete pure lower offered flags, positive October grades 3–8 and explicit-zero grades 9–12. Select matching same-year school individual PIMS income and original regular PSSA All Students / Total subject records. Keep all 162 grade profiles; retain high/mixed/primary/inactive/unmatched/native-9999/subgroup/grade rows through the immutable complete source. No name joins, income backfill, diagnostic exclusions or charter-LEA substitutions.
policy.models: Separate unweighted centered 2024–25 Philadelphia grade-school Math, ELA and independently fitted paired Combined OLS. Combined is the equally weighted mean of original subject rates with its own residual scale, every deleted fit and external studentization; never average subject studentized residuals. No enrollment weights, shrinkage, fit-driven exclusions or national pooling.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals use every explicit deleted-school fit, N−3 deleted residual degrees of freedom and held-out leverage. Rank-two full/deleted designs and positive finite scales are hard gates. Cook distance and prediction sensitivity over the observed income range are descriptive, never exclusions or prediction clamping.
policy.intervals: Every eligible member has original verified subject Number Scored. Jeffreys p=(published_pct/100*n+0.5)/(n+1), v=10000*p*(1−p)/n; Combined uses (sqrt(vMath)+sqrt(vELA))²/4, the maximum positive covariance bound. Propagate every model member through (I−H), holding each deleted regression scale fixed, for externally studentized t±1.96SE approximate conditional intervals. Count, date, population, rounded-rate, binomial and fixed-scale assumptions remain explicit; these are not causal or overall-school-quality intervals.
policy.combined_count_display: Combined displays the smaller original Math/ELA Number Scored only as a conservative subject-count display; it is not a paired, deduplicated or joint denominator. Preserve both exact subject counts and references; use both subject variances with the maximum positive covariance bound.
policy.compact_provenance: The complete immutable source retains all 22,108 original records / 622,260 typed cells, complete headers, notes, primary definitions and outside identities. Every numerical API/replay, including cached expected fits, requires the current complete blob, source code/tests, source policy/raw/schema/definition/identity and secondary extract pins plus semantic validation. Compact exact input table/worksheet/row/column references avoid duplicating raw tables/PDFs.
policy.release: Numerical audit only pending independent review and separate canonical/browser integration. Historical source and numerical source/modeling approvals stay false; verified scored denominators and numerical intervals never grant publication approval.

retained_source_reference.note: Complete original records, headers, notes, definitions, membership and outside identities stay in the immutable linked source artifact; every numerical replay requires current available unchanged source/code/tests/policy and semantic validation.

count_definition_status.reason: Every eligible rate has its exact original same-year regular PSSA All Students/Total Number Scored denominator; source floor is 11, observed minimum 42. Combined retains both subject counts and uses the smaller only for display, never a paired denominator.

review_warnings: Conditional sampling intervals propagate every member’s verified Number Scored binomial approximation while holding deleted regression scale fixed; they do not measure causal school effects or all sources of uncertainty.
Conventional leverage, Cook distance and residual flags require descriptive review, never automatic exclusions.

Individual October PIMS poverty coverage, local poverty-source choices, enrolled pre-K/kindergarten, accountable assessment exclusions and one-decimal published-rate rounding remain explicit limits; predictions are never clamped.
Combined uses maximum positive subject covariance and displays the smaller original subject count, not a paired or deduplicated denominator.

intervals.method: Every eligible member has original verified subject Number Scored. Jeffreys p=(published_pct/100*n+0.5)/(n+1), v=10000*p*(1−p)/n; Combined uses (sqrt(vMath)+sqrt(vELA))²/4, the maximum positive covariance bound. Propagate every model member through (I−H), holding each deleted regression scale fixed, for externally studentized t±1.96SE approximate conditional intervals. Count, date, population, rounded-rate, binomial and fixed-scale assumptions remain explicit; these are not causal or overall-school-quality intervals.
intervals.combined_count_display: Combined displays the smaller original Math/ELA Number Scored only as a conservative subject-count display; it is not a paired, deduplicated or joint denominator. Preserve both exact subject counts and references; use both subject variances with the maximum positive covariance bound.
intervals.assumptions: Approximate conditional 95% intervals: independent school rate errors, smoothed binomial variances from rounded published rates, fixed income/design and fixed deleted regression scale; all model members contribute. Combined takes the maximum positive Math/ELA covariance bound.

diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive influence flags only; no school is excluded by leverage, residual or fit quality. Original one-decimal proficiency, October individual PIMS income, accountable PSSA scored scope and approximate conditional sampling assumptions remain limitations; predictions are never clamped.

independent_verification.method: Centered full OLS; centered closed-form leverage; every explicit leave-one-out fit uses N−3 scale and held-out variance factor 1+h_deleted. Independent scalar centered hat weights propagate every member’s verified Jeffreys variance through (I−H); conditional external-t endpoints hold each explicit deleted scale fixed. Combined uses the maximum positive Math/ELA covariance variance bound and preserves both original scored counts; its smaller display count is not a paired denominator.

review_warnings: Conditional sampling intervals propagate every member’s verified Number Scored binomial approximation while holding deleted regression scale fixed; they do not measure causal school effects or all sources of uncertainty.
Conventional leverage, Cook distance and residual flags require descriptive review, never automatic exclusions.

Individual October PIMS poverty coverage, local poverty-source choices, enrolled pre-K/kindergarten, accountable assessment exclusions and one-decimal published-rate rounding remain explicit limits; predictions are never clamped.
Combined uses maximum positive subject covariance and displays the smaller original subject count, not a paired or deduplicated denominator.

intervals.method: Every eligible member has original verified subject Number Scored. Jeffreys p=(published_pct/100*n+0.5)/(n+1), v=10000*p*(1−p)/n; Combined uses (sqrt(vMath)+sqrt(vELA))²/4, the maximum positive covariance bound. Propagate every model member through (I−H), holding each deleted regression scale fixed, for externally studentized t±1.96SE approximate conditional intervals. Count, date, population, rounded-rate, binomial and fixed-scale assumptions remain explicit; these are not causal or overall-school-quality intervals.
intervals.combined_count_display: Combined displays the smaller original Math/ELA Number Scored only as a conservative subject-count display; it is not a paired, deduplicated or joint denominator. Preserve both exact subject counts and references; use both subject variances with the maximum positive covariance bound.
intervals.assumptions: Approximate conditional 95% intervals: independent school rate errors, smoothed binomial variances from rounded published rates, fixed income/design and fixed deleted regression scale; all model members contribute. Combined takes the maximum positive Math/ELA covariance bound.

diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive influence flags only; no school is excluded by leverage, residual or fit quality. Original one-decimal proficiency, October individual PIMS income, accountable PSSA scored scope and approximate conditional sampling assumptions remain limitations; predictions are never clamped.

independent_verification.method: Centered full OLS; centered closed-form leverage; every explicit leave-one-out fit uses N−3 scale and held-out variance factor 1+h_deleted. Independent scalar centered hat weights propagate every member’s verified Jeffreys variance through (I−H); conditional external-t endpoints hold each explicit deleted scale fixed. Combined uses the maximum positive Math/ELA covariance variance bound and preserves both original scored counts; its smaller display count is not a paired denominator.
